arguments.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type, character_maximum_length, numeric_precision, numeric_scale, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position

SELECT conrelid::regclass AS tbl, conname, contype, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS def FROM pg_constraint WHERE connamespace NOT IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')) ORDER BY 1,2
